title: Hold a write for a person
description: The gate holds an agent's write as a draft for a person when the confidence the write carries is below the line. A yes is a held write. A write without a confidence is never held for confidence and is not a trial.
call_site: packages/naive/src/engine/gate.mjs when.confidence_below, read through naive.config.json thresholds.confidence (packages/naive/src/engine/naive-config.mjs configFor)

question.text: Does this write need a person before it lands?

evidence.sensor: the agent that wrote the record, through provenance.confidence on the write

sources.note: The confidence each agent write carries

scale.meaning: The writing agent's confidence in the write, 0 to 1

note: yes_when below matches the gate's strict comparison: a confidence below 0.7 is held, and exactly 0.7 passes. Costly tier, so a bad write let through (a miss) costs three times a held write a person accepts unchanged (a false alarm). naive.config.json thresholds.confidence, and a number in a rule's confidence_below, still take precedence over this line.
